; colorDropdownOnMove.qmd - xochitl 3.28 (tested against 3.28.0.172 sources)
;
; Turns the Redo toolbar button into a color picker for the active pen.
; The button shows a dot in the current pen color. Tap it to open a grid of
; colors (the same palette as the pen menu). Picking a color applies it to the
; active pen (primary or secondary) and closes the panel. The button is moved next to the second pen.
; The button is disabled while the eraser or selection tool is active.
;
; Colors go through toolbar.penColorSelected(rgb, paletteEnum). DocumentView
; handles that signal and writes documentViewTools.activePen.color/.colorCode.
; That is the same path the stock pen menu uses.
;
; Optional thickness row below the colors. It is hidden for highlighters, which have no
; thickness choice, the same rule the pen menu uses. Thickness goes through
; toolbar.penThicknessSelected(thickness).
; Turn it on or off in Settings, below "Toolbar position". The value is stored with QtCore
; Settings (category "colorDropdownOnMove") and takes effect the next time a document is opened.

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/RedoButton.qml
    IMPORT com.remarkable 1.0
    IMPORT xofm.libs.epaper 1.0 Epaper
    IMPORT QtCore 6.5 QtCore

    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        REPLACE objectName WITH { objectName: "colorDropdownButton" }
        REPLACE label WITH { label: qsTr("Color") }
        REPLACE iconSource WITH { iconSource: "" }
        REPLACE enabled WITH { enabled: root.writingPenActive }
        REPLACE implicitlySelected WITH { implicitlySelected: root.foldoutVisible }
        ; The stock tooltip is tied to the Redo onboarding and to press/release logic we no longer use.
        REPLACE toolTip WITH { toolTip: null }
        ; Non-sticky tool (like Tags): the first press opens the foldout, the second press
        ; returns to the previously selected pen (Toolbar._select -> selectLastTool).
        REPLACE onPressed WITH { onPressed: root.select(root) }
        REPLACE onClicked WITH { onClicked: {} }
        REPLACE onReleased WITH { onReleased: {} }
        REPLACE onCanceled WITH { onCanceled: {} }

        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            // toolbar.selectedPen is the PenTool item (primary/secondary/eraser/selection menu).
            readonly property Item selectedPenTool: root.toolbar.selectedPen
            readonly property QtObject pen: selectedPenTool ? selectedPenTool.pen : null
            readonly property bool writingPenActive: !!selectedPenTool
                && (selectedPenTool.penToolType === "primary" || selectedPenTool.penToolType === "secondary")
            // Same rule as the stock pen menu (WritingTool.hasWidthOption).
            readonly property bool penHasWidthOption: !!root.pen
                && root.pen.tool !== Line.Highlighterv2 && root.pen.tool !== Line.Highlighter
            readonly property bool showThicknessRow: dropdownSettings.showThickness && root.penHasWidthOption
            hasMinimumFoldoutWidth: false

            QtCore.Settings {
                id: dropdownSettings
                category: "colorDropdownOnMove"
                property bool showThickness: true
            }

            PenColorModel {
                id: dropdownColorModel
                tool: root.pen ? root.pen.tool : 0
                colorProfile: root.toolbar.toolbarProvider.colorProfile
            }

            PenThicknessModel {
                id: dropdownThicknessModel
            }

            // Button face: a dot in the active pen's color (same style as the pen menu indicator).
            content: Item {
                id: dropdownIndicator
                anchors.fill: parent

                readonly property color bodyColor: root.pen
                    ? dropdownColorModel.displayColor(root.pen.color, root.pen.colorCode)
                    : "transparent"
                readonly property bool highlighted: root.selected || root.implicitlySelected

                Rectangle {
                    id: dropdownDot
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    width: 34
                    height: 34
                    radius: width / 2
                    color: root.writingPenActive ? dropdownIndicator.bodyColor : "transparent"
                    border.width: 2
                    border.color: dropdownIndicator.highlighted ? "white" : (root.writingPenActive ? "black" : "gray")
                    antialiasing: root.antialiasing

                    Epaper.ScreenModeItem {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: 4
                        visible: EPFramebuffer.hasCapability(EPFramebuffer.Capability.Color)
                        mode: Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Content
                        objectName: "color-dropdown-color"
                    }
                }
            }

            foldoutContent: ColumnLayout {
                spacing: 0

                ArkControls.FoldoutSectionHeader {
                    label: qsTr("Color")
                    antialiasing: root.antialiasing
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                }

                FoldoutGrid {
                    columns: 3
                    Layout.fillWidth: true

                    Repeater {
                        model: dropdownColorModel
                        ArkControls.FoldoutGridItem {
                            id: dropdownColorItem
                            required property var displayColor
                            required property string displayName
                            required property int toolColor
                            required property var rgb
                            required property bool stacked
                            required property int borderWidth
                            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                            label: qsTranslate("xofm::libs::toolbar::PenColorModel", displayName)
                            selected: {
                                if (!root.pen || root.pen.color !== toolColor) {
                                    return false;
                                }
                                if (toolColor === Line.ArgbCode) {
                                    return rgb === root.pen.colorCode;
                                }
                                return true;
                            }
                            iconComponent: ArkControls.ColorSwatch {
                                size: 39
                                borderColor: dropdownColorItem.selected ? "white" : "black"
                                color: displayColor
                                duoColor: stacked ? Qt.darker(displayColor, 1.6) : ""
                                duoOpacity: 1
                                antialiasing: false
                                borderWidth: dropdownColorItem.borderWidth
                                rotation: stacked && borderWidth == 0 ? 90 : 0
                            }
                            onPressed: {
                                root.toolbar.penColorSelected(rgb, toolColor);
                                root.toolbar.selectLastTool();
                            }
                            implicitWidth: 112
                            implicitHeight: 112
                            // Work-around for incorrect spacing applied by FoldoutGridItem (copied from PenTool):
                            Component.onCompleted: contentItem.spacing = 8
                        }
                    }
                }

                ArkControls.FoldoutDivider {
                    visible: root.showThicknessRow
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                }

                ArkControls.FoldoutSectionHeader {
                    visible: root.showThicknessRow
                    label: root.pen
                        ? qsTranslate(dropdownThicknessModel.translationContext(), dropdownThicknessModel.nameForThickness(root.pen.thickness))
                        : ""
                    antialiasing: root.antialiasing
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                }

                FoldoutGrid {
                    visible: root.showThicknessRow
                    columns: 3
                    Layout.fillWidth: true

                    Repeater {
                        model: dropdownThicknessModel
                        ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                            required property string iconPath
                            required property string displayName
                            required property int thickness
                            iconSource: iconPath
                            selected: !!root.pen && root.pen.thickness === thickness
                            antialiasing: root.antialiasing
                            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                            onPressed: {
                                root.toolbar.penThicknessSelected(thickness);
                                root.toolbar.selectLastTool();
                            }
                            implicitWidth: implicitHeight
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Settings toggle, shown below the "Toolbar position" panel in Settings.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/toolbar/qml/ToolbarPositionChooserWidget.qml
    IMPORT QtCore 6.5 QtCore

    TRAVERSE Item#root
        REPLACE implicitHeight WITH {
            implicitHeight: panel.implicitHeight + colorDropdownPanel.implicitHeight
        }

        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            QtCore.Settings {
                id: colorDropdownSettings
                category: "colorDropdownOnMove"
                property bool showThickness: true
            }

            ArkControls.Panel {
                id: colorDropdownPanel
                y: panel.height
                width: parent.width
                label: qsTr("Color picker: thickness")
                description: qsTr("Show pen thickness below the colors in the toolbar color picker.")
                action: ArkControls.Toggle {
                    checked: colorDropdownSettings.showThickness
                    onClicked: colorDropdownSettings.showThickness = !colorDropdownSettings.showThickness
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Move the button next to the second pen. Toolbar order comes from the device config:
; PrimaryPen 0, SecondaryPen 10, Typing 20, Eraser 30, ... Redo 70.
; chiappa.json only overrides the keys it lists, so setting "order" on Redo is enough.
; This is inserted right after "tools": { so it doesn't touch the SecondaryPen entry
; that enableSecondaryPenOnMove.qmd looks for.
AFFECT REBUILD /src/xofm/bundles/chiappa/chiappa.json
LOCATE AFTER STREAM \"tools": {\
INSERT STREAM \"Redo": { "order": 15 },\
END REBUILD
